title: Toward Substantive Intersectional Algorithmic Fairness: Desiderata for a Feminist Approach
findings: The paper does not present empirical findings related to religion. It argues theoretically that religion is one of several intersecting social categories (along with race, gender, class, etc.) that must be considered in a substantive approach to algorithmic fairness. An example is provided where a person's gender identity was most salient in 'religious settings' in Egypt, illustrating the context-dependent nature of intersecting identities.
